reachability.mainlandProbe: Ubuntu 24.04 host in Beijing (39.106.154.227), no proxy
reachability.detail: From the mainland egress every path failed with connect ETIMEDOUT against four different resolved addresses (103.56.16.112, 108.160.167.156, 199.59.148.15, 31.13.96.194), which is the classic DNS-interference pattern. Cloudflare also sells a separate China Network product, so this is consistent rather than surprising.

evidence.reason: Measured, not just documented. wrangler 4.131.1 deployed an assets-only Worker with `wrangler deploy --temporary` and no account, and the printed URL served every file byte-identically (/, /index.html, /index and both assets returned 200; / and /index.html also served the exact uploaded bytes, so there is no HTML injection). The CLI printed a claim URL and a 60-minute claim window. From the mainland egress, however, every path timed out, so the deployment is NOT reachable there: independentReaderVerified stays false and the provider must not be enabled for a China-facing default.

notes: claimDeadline is null because the deadline is printed per deploy rather than fixed by the API. Two corrections to the public record: an assets-only Worker works with --temporary (the docs only describe Workers generally), and workers.dev is unreachable from a mainland datacenter egress on this date.
